name_en: Orido nasu dengaku — a native eggplant variety grilled and topped with sweet miso
summary_ja: 静岡市三保の在来種、折戸なすを両面焼き、赤みそに酒・砂糖・みりんを練り合わせたたれをのせる。徳川家康が好んだ「一富士、二鷹、三茄子」の茄子と伝わり、濃厚な味わいが味噌料理と相性が良いとされる。
summary_en: Orido nasu, a native eggplant grown in Miho, Shizuoka, is grilled on both sides and topped with red miso simmered with sake, sugar, and mirin. Said to be the eggplant of the "first Fuji, second hawk, third eggplant" New Year's luck saying, its richness is said to suit miso well.
source_title: 折戸なすの田楽 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
